declared.title: Development, Freedom, and Rising Happiness: A Global Perspective (1981–2007)
declared.foundIn: recherche Crossref « development freedom and rising happiness global perspective » du 2026-11-22 (piste « liberté de choix et bonheur entre pays ») ; titre relevé sur Crossref : contrôle d'identité plus faible

population: representative national surveys, 1981-2007, 52 countries with time series (countries not listed in the abstract)

findings.text: Societies that allow more free choice have happier people; the authors read this regression link as a major effect

support.sentence: Regression analyses suggest that that the extent to which a society allows free choice has a major impact on happiness.

limits: an association between nations, not an experiment on people
perceived freedom and control over one's life, not the number of options in a choice
whether Middle East or North African countries are among the 52 is not said in the abstract
allegiance: the link is predicted by the authors' own human development model
